title: Audit brand asset completeness
description: Verify all logos have PNG, SVG, and favicon variants for both BBI and Mereka brands

title: Reconcile upstream Mereka token semantics with the LMS magenta and Poppins contract
description: Remove ambiguity between the upstream Mereka brand files and the current Mereka LMS product contract. The LMS canonical primary is magenta #ab3b78 and teal #237072 remains secondary. The active LMS typography contract is Poppins-only, while this repository currently documents Lato headings plus Poppins body. Reconcile this truth explicitly: if Poppins-only is now global, update all machine-readable and human-readable guides together; if it is LMS-specific, publish a named machine-readable LMS consumer profile while retaining the truthful global guide. Do not make the LMS copy raw upstream files or preserve local_override prose as the derivation mechanism. This upstream task is related to, but does not block, the local fail-closed provenance and generator repair in mereka-lms.
acceptance_criteria:
AC-001: Machine-readable upstream truth identifies #ab3b78 as the Mereka LMS primary/brand semantic and #237072 as secondary; no field or comment describes teal as the LMS primary.
AC-002: Typography is unambiguous: either all authoritative global formats move together to Poppins-only, or a named LMS consumer profile declares Poppins-only while the global Lato-heading/Poppins-body contract remains intact.
AC-003: brands/mereka/tokens/tokens.css, relevant README/docs, and brand-guidelines MD/YAML/JSON agree on semantic roles; generated or profile files have a documented generation/check command.
AC-004: The change preserves master logo assets and distinguishes logo artwork font provenance from active product UI typography.
AC-005: The merged commit and SHA-256 of the exact upstream source/profile are suitable for fail-closed consumption by Mereka LMS provenance.json.
AC-006: Automated drift checks fail when primary color or active heading/body font semantics disagree across authoritative formats.
notes: Created from an independent ChatGPT GPT-5.6 Sol Pro review completed 2026-07-15 and reconciled against Mereka LMS GitHub issues #210 and #217 plus PR #5336. Current upstream state is internally truthful for the historic global guide (#ab3b78, Lato headings, Poppins body); the defect is that the LMS-specific Poppins-only contract is not represented upstream without ambiguity. This bead deliberately permits a named LMS profile instead of falsifying the global guide.
